nodes.summary: The inverse of a nonsingular M-matrix is entrywise nonnegative (Berman–Plemmons, Ch. 6, Theorem 2.3, (G20) ⇒ (N38)).
nodes.title: Inverse positivity of M-matrices

nodes.summary: If `K` is entrywise nonnegative with spectral radius `< 1`, then `(1 - K)⁻¹` is entrywise nonnegative (the proof identifies it with the limit of the partial sums `∑_{n<N} Kⁿ`).
nodes.title: Neumann series

nodes.summary: A real square matrix is Hurwitz if every complex eigenvalue has negative real part.
nodes.title: Hurwitz matrix

nodes.summary: A nonsingular M-matrix is a Z-matrix all of whose complex eigenvalues have positive real part (Berman–Plemmons, Ch. 6, Theorem 2.3, condition (G20)).
nodes.title: Nonsingular M-matrix

nodes.summary: If the spectral radius of `K` is `< 1`, then `1` is not an eigenvalue of `K`, so `1 - K` is invertible.
nodes.title: Invertibility of 1 − K when the spectral radius is below one

nodes.summary: A Z-matrix has nonpositive off-diagonal entries.
nodes.title: Z-matrix

nodes.summary: If `K ≥ 0` entrywise, `z ≥ 0`, `z ≠ 0` and `r • z ≤ K *ᵥ z` with `r ≥ 0`, then `r` is at most the spectral radius of `K`.
nodes.title: Collatz–Wielandt lower bound

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
